title: Level 5 (World Class) - B-11
notes:
West leads the ♠K against 6♥. West wins the opening spade lead and continues the suit, South ruffing. West's bidding has shown a very strong 2 suiter in spades and diamonds. West certainly has the ♦K.

South should continue a low heart to the dummy. West's discard marks the 4-0 trump break. South must now hope to squeeze West in spades and diamonds. South must time the play carefully. Four rounds of clubs are cashed, throwing a diamond from dummy on the fourth round. South crosses in hearts and plays a spade from dummy.

East must ruff to stop a cross ruff. If South had tried a spade from dummy before cashing the clubs, East would have discarded a club, leaving South no chance. South overruffs and cashes the rest of North's hearts. On the last trump West is squeezed.
